sections.title: Rider profile and constraints
sections.text: Works full-time, rides 4 mornings a week before 07:30. Indoor only until March. Prefers short, hard sessions to long easy ones.
sections.reason: The rider said Friday is no longer free.

sections.title: What works
sections.text: Two quality sessions a week with a rest day after each.

sections.title: What does not work
sections.text: Three hard days in a row: fatigue shows by day three.

sections.title: Injuries and niggles
sections.text: Left knee niggle after long standing efforts; keep cadence above 85.

sections.title: Methodology
sections.text: Base block, then sweet spot progression. Weekly structure: two key sessions, one endurance ride, two rest days. Review on 2027-01-10.
sections.reason: Rider's FTP test came in lower than assumed; moving the build back by two weeks.

sections.title: Open questions
sections.text: Does the rider have access to a heart-rate strap on every ride?

sections.title: Decisions log
sections.text:
2026-11-10 Moved Thursday's threshold to Friday after the rider's long day.
2026-11-16 FTP lowered to 240 W after the test.
